simple.meaning: גִּבֵּן (gibbên) is a Hebrew word meaning “hunch-backed.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

simple.summary: גִּבֵּן (gibbên) / H1384 is traced through Leviticus 21:20 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H1384. gibben גִּבֵּן adjective crook-backed, hump-backed (compare Aramaic גְּבִין id. , Late Hebrew גַּבָּן highlander ; also Late Hebrew גבין , Aramaic גבינא , , all = brow ( eye-brow , etc.); compare Arabic side of forehead ), Lev 21:20 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to be arched or contracted;

occurrences.englishText: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.
